name: Email Verification Resend Throttled
summary: A resend request arrives during the resend cooldown, no replacement proof is issued, and email ownership remains unverified.

sourceState.expression: durable identity exists and email ownership is unverified

destinationTransform.valueExpression: preserve the current verification proof unchanged

requiredEffects: Do not issue a replacement verification proof while the cooldown is active.
forbiddenEffects: Do not consume the current verification proof solely because resend was throttled.

sourceReferences.note: Cooldown is authoritative server state; resend-throttled is only the presentation state used to render and verify the result.
